review.notes: No code fences in the OCR, so no fence-swallowing; the numbered heading tree matches the PDF sections and no prompt-box item, figure banner or chart title was promoted to a heading. A normalized word diff (case/punctuation-insensitive, LaTeX math collapsed, HTML table markup ignored) covered all 56 physical pages; physical pages 1, 26 and 45 were additionally rendered (120-300 dpi) and visually verified for every patch. Repairs found: one misread word inside the printed Figure 9 task bubble (rainfall for raindrop) and two dropped footnote bodies whose markers survive in the OCR (the page-1 asterisk footnote under Figure 1 and the page-45 author-role footnote), restored next to the text blocks they annotate. Everything else that diverges from the PDF text layer is intentionally out of scope of the reader text: arXiv margin stamp, cover watermark date and folio numerals (page furniture); text inside figure composites for Figures 4, 7, 8, 9-11, 13-17, 19-21 and the appendix examples, which is carried by the embedded figure images with all 26 'Figure N:' captions present in the OCR; hyphenation joins (digi tal -> digital); LaTeX-equivalent equation notation; and kerning-split names/URLs in the contributor list and references that the OCR correctly rejoined. All benchmark tables (Tables 1-13) were covered by the word diff and their values match, including 82.1/92.2/97.5 in the abstract, the OSWorld 79.5/40.0 block and the WebArena/DeepSearch tables.

patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.26 Figure 9 task bubble prints 'Please identify the photo of Hong Kong and select the correct and usable raindrop filter and snowflake filter.' (visually verified at 300 dpi); the OCR misread raindrop as rainfall in the same sentence.
